_source: In-game Reputation > Quests screenshots. Liyue 30 Oct 2026, Inazuma 7 Nov 2026, Inazuma re-read 11 Nov 2026. Only quests showing 'Claimed' are listed. This is the one fact no API exposes - progress is server-side - so it has to be transcribed by hand.
_names: Entries use the WIKI title, not the in-game row, where the two differ. The game shows 'Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual: Yougou Cleansing'; the wiki page is 'Yougou Cleansing'. The game shows 'Seirai Stormchasers'; the wiki splits the series and only 'Seirai Stormchasers: Part IV' pays reputation, which the prefix match picks up.

_outstanding: Inazuma_outstanding is the in-game 'Not achieved' list, read from screenshots on 11 Nov 2026. Unlike the claimed list this one IS complete: 12 claimed + 33 outstanding = 45, which equals the 60 rows in reputation-quests.json minus its 15 Requests. Requests live in their own tab and are not in either list.
_inazuma_status: Direct evidence 11 Nov 2026: International Travel Log shows Claimed, so the earlier rollback was wrong - it was done, just not yet collected when the 16/45 screen was read. Per-quest list is now 18. The last COUNTER reading was 17/45 at 4,080 EXP (Level 7, 630/750), which is consistent if that shot predates this claim: at that moment 5 of the 6 post-baseline quests were collected, and ITL made the sixth. INFERRED current state: 18/45, 4,180 EXP, 20 short of Level 8 (4,200). Inferred, not read - confirm against the bar before trusting it.
_pending: Inazuma_completed_unclaimed: finished in game but NOT yet seen as Claimed on the Reputation screen. These move to Inazuma and leave Inazuma_outstanding only when a screen reading confirms them. Keeping them separate is what the 16/45-vs-17 drift on 11 Nov cost; a finished quest pays nothing until collected from Madarame Hyakubei, so 'done' and 'claimed' are genuinely different states and the data needs both.
